title: Rams honor their history with new 'Classic Sol' and 'Fearsome White' uniforms

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams honor their history with new 'Classic Sol' and 'Fearsome White' uniforms
sources.description: The Rams pay tribute to their 1951 NFL championship and its "Fearsome Foursome" of the 1960s and '70s with two new uniforms for the 2026 season.
